extracted.name: Breakfast Berry Bowl
extracted.description: This is a quick and healthy breakfast choice my fiance and I came up with one morning when we were in a hurry. We love lots of colors in our food choices! Enjoy!
ingredient_lines: This recipe can be altered to your preference of fruit as well
instruction_lines: Wash and rinse your fresh fruits with cold water in a colander
Cut the necessary fruit into slices and then into halves
Toss all the fruits into a bigger bowl to combine together
Once fruit is combined choose your favorite yogurt and toss it into the fresh fruit. Enjoy!
